title: The Wolf Winter
text: Wolves came down from the Rift side of the hills with the first snow. They are too big, and they walk upright when they think nobody is looking. Last night they took the watchman off the north wall without a sound. The walls need iron, and the garrisons need feeding.

temptation.label: Sell your iron to the trappers, at trappers' prices.
temptation.text: The pelts the trappers bring back are worth a fortune. Some of them have hands.

triumph.text: Spears and fires hold the walls all winter. In the thaw the hunters bring back a skull the size of a cart, which the city hangs over the gate.

holds.text: The walls hold; the outlying farms do not. Nobody goes to see what is left of them.

falters.text: They come over the wall on the longest night. By morning the snow in the lower town is pink. One of your recruits is gone with the rest.

calamity.text: The wolves winter inside the walls, where they learn the Seats' doors. The Scions who fight them are never quite warm again.
